title: A `match` arm that calls a `void` method stops with an internal error.
text: `match ($n) { 1 => A::f(), default => A::f() };`, where `A::f` returns `void`, passes the checker, and the build then stops with `E0901` ("internal error: a phi of representation `void`"). With one `void` arm and one `print` arm, or with the `match` assigned to a `mixed` local, it stops with `E0901` ("an operand used before it is defined"). A `void` call has no value, so an arm that is one is `E0707` where it is written, as `echo` of a `void` call is. It closes when that is so, with a conformance case.
